target_customer: Teams training models with reinforcement learning, building RL environments or running agent evals
problem: Flaws in RL environments and graders let models reward hack, which wastes training and makes capability gains hard to interpret.
business_model: Applied research lab selling auditing tools and services for RL environments and evals; pricing not stated

founders.name: Rohit Agarwal
education: PhD student, Princeton PLI, Hazan Lab
founders.background_notes: Theory research at Berkeley per YC page.

founders.name: Andrew Liu
education: BA Computer Science, Mathematics and Linguistics, UC Berkeley

founders.name: Kev Wang
founders.background_notes: Member of technical staff at SkyPilot; founding engineer at Eventual from seed to Series A per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Detecting subtle grader and environment flaws needs research-level understanding of RL and model behavior; the team is research heavy. They report finding 110 issues in Terminal-Bench, DeepSWE and BFCL, a company claim.

defensibility.rationale: Research reputation and published audits are hard to copy quickly, but labs can build internal tooling.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Unknown. Frontier labs publish reward hacking research and run their own checks.

market_need_then: Labs invested heavily in RL environments by 2025 and 2026, and reward hacking was widely discussed in published research, creating demand for environment quality.

identity.visual_style: Research lab site with named tools Eval3 and EnvCheck
identity.voice_and_tone: Mission statement tone: our goal is to end reward hacking

branding.brand_signature: Named audit tools such as EnvCheck and Eval3 with a public leaderboard

brand_strength.rationale: Early; the tool names carry more identity than the company name, and no outside press on the brand found.

outcome_analysis: Tokenless is active from the Summer 2026 batch with no outcome yet. Its research credentialed founders and public audit tools give it credibility in a niche that frontier labs also work on. No funding beyond YC is public.
notes: Funding search found only the YC page, no amounts. Competitor search found no commercial reward hacking detection vendors dated near the batch, so the list is empty.
